dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト), GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL-based system for Japanese medical billing
evidence: COPY MCPAREA / ORCA-SPA / LINKAREA pattern typical of JMA ORCA
COPY Z01.INC through Z100.INC screen area copybooks

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance claim (receipt/rezept) output screen processing for the JMA ORCA standard medical billing system
purpose.summary: This program (ORCGZ100) is the output instruction screen (Z100) component of the JMA ORCA medical receipt software. It handles initialization, screen transitions, and input validation for CSV output of point-number master settings, including filename checks and client-save functionality. It supports both standard Linux and GINBEE (a specific deployment environment) output paths.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (29 copybooks) for screen and SPA areas
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple COPY-based areas (MCPAREA, ORCA-SPA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA)
MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT driven screen navigation (ORCA MCP framework)
GINBEE environment detection via SPA-MW = SPA-GINBEE
STRING verb for dynamic CSV filename construction
PERFORM VARYING with nested IF for filename validation
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS (uses proprietary MCP framework instead)
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP (Latin-1 decoded), causing garbled display of Japanese comments. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. The 'online-cics' program_type is used loosely here — ORCA uses its own MCP (Medical Care Platform) framework analogous to CICS for screen handling, not actual CICS. Revision history shows updates through 2014 (04.08.01 = version 4.8.1).
